ns2:course.label: Diseases of Field Crops
ns2:course.description: Studies the symptoms of major field crop diseases, life histories of causal organisms, and methods of control. Lecture and laboratory. Same as CPSC 407. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PLPA 204 or PLPA 401.
